title: Ndị Nkwanye Ùgwù Ndị E Kwere Ekwe
intro: Onye amụma a na-asọpụrụ jere ije n'etiti ndị mmadụ, na-akpọ ha òkù ka ha bịaruo eziokwu. Ọtụtụ ndị tụgharịrị n'isi ike, mana obere ndị raara onwe ha nye zara oku ahụ ma kwe nkwa onwe ha n'obi ha niile. A nwalere ha n'obi abụọ ma nwaa ha ịchọ ihe oriri eluigwe. Nraranye ha na-enweghị mgbagha ghọrọ ihe mmụta na-adịghị agwụ agwụ n'okwukwe. Ònye ka ha bụ?
clues: Anyị bụ obere otu ndị biliri iji kwado ọrụ Chineke n'oge a na-anaghị ekwenye ekwenye nke ukwuu.
Otu onye amụma a na-asọpụrụ bịara wee kpọọ anyị ka anyị kwado onwe anyị n'ihe gbasara Allah.
Mgbe onye amụma jụrụ onye ga-akwado Chineke, anyị zara ya n'egbughị oge.
Anyị nwere obi ike ịrịọ maka oriri ọrụ ebube e si n'eluigwe bịa iji mee ka obi anyị sie ike.
Onye amụma anyị chetaara anyị ka anyị na-atụ egwu Allah ma ọ bụrụ na anyị bụ ezigbo ndị kwere ekwe, mana a mezuru arịrịọ anyị dị umeala n'obi.
Anyị bụ ndị gbara ezi obi n'ime anyị, ndị kwere nkwa okwukwe na-enweghị mgbagha n'akụkụ Isa, nwa Meri.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Hawariyyun (Ndị na-eso ụzọ Isa)
Ashab al-Kahf (Ndị Ọgba)
Ndị Midian
Ndị Temọd
Ndị Enyi Talut (Sọl)

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịrịọ ka ha bụrụ ndị na-akwado ebumnuche Allah
Ịhụ arụmụka onye ọchịchị na onye amụma
Ịbụ onye e nyere iwu ka ọ hapụ nne kamel dị ebube
Ịgbaga n'ọgba iji gbanahụ mkpagbu
Ịgafe osimiri iji nwalee nrubeisi
trial.answer: Ịrịọ ka ha bụrụ ndị na-akwado ebumnuche Allah

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Tebụl e si n'eluigwe gbasaa (Mawlida)
Ụgbọ ukwu ahụ dị n'elu mmiri idei mmiri
Nne kamel nke si n'okwute pụta
Mkpanaka nke gbanwere ghọọ agwọ

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Anyị ghọrọ ndị kwere ekwe siri ike ma nwee mmeri
E bibiri anyị site n'ahụhụ sitere n'elu
Idei mmiri dị ukwuu kpuchiri anyị.
Anyị dinara n'ọgba ruo ọtụtụ narị afọ
A machibidoro anyị ịbanye n'ala nsọ ahụ
outcome.answer: Anyị ghọrọ ndị kwere ekwe siri ike ma nwee mmeri

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
